name: web-tools
description: The portable set from mehrlander/web-tools as installable plugins: the working-conventions loader, the surfacing caption, the skill-library loader, the show-repo instrument, and the daisy-alpine reference.

plugins.name: portable
plugins.description: The to-go bag: the working-conventions loader, the surfacing caption, the skill-library loader, the show-repo instrument, the tracker operator, and the rest of the portable skill set; the roster, one line per skill, is docs/PORTABLE.md's bag table, indexed in docs/portable.csv and held to disk by tools/test/portable-manifest.test.mjs, so this description does not enumerate it. Also carries five hooks that run on their own: the session recorder (Stop), inert unless a checkout declares a sessions store, the session dispatcher (SessionStart), which runs every checkout's own .claude/hooks/session-*.sh whatever the project root is, the MCP failure hint (PostToolUseFailure), which turns a -32003 approval wall into the sandbox-traps connector-vs-builtin diagnosis at the moment it fires, the PR-subscribe hint (PostToolUse), and the reading-column guard (PreToolUse), which refuses a Tailwind class that narrows text to a reading column. Vendors the two conventions docs and an injector a repo can opt into through the dispatcher, so loading them costs no fetch.

plugins.name: daisy-alpine
plugins.description: The HTML house style (the style guide for pages: no stat cards, no page prose, browsing takes the viewport) plus the DaisyUI 5 + Tailwind 4 + Alpine.js mechanics. Model-invocable, so it triggers on matching artifact work without being asked, and it leads with the binding half because a description selling syntax reference is one a model declines when it already knows the syntax.

plugins.name: google-style-clarity
plugins.description: Google developer-documentation style, applied to clarity: name the referent, explain the term, state the relationship, describe the operation behind a metaphor, match the claim to the evidence, and separate an instruction from a recommendation. Every principle cites the guide section it comes from, and a second table of wording to leave alone holds the restraint. Model-invocable, so it triggers on drafting and review work without being asked.
